title: Azure Malware Scanning & File Quarantine
domain: CLOUD SECURITY / MALWARE SCANNING / EVENT SYSTEMS
subtitle: Keep uploaded files unavailable until the exact version passes its malware check.
scenario: A workforce platform accepts applicant and employee documents. Saving a file is not enough to make it safe to preview or download: the application needs a trusted malware result for the exact stored bytes, even when events arrive late or more than once.
outcome: Reduce the risk of distributing malicious or unverified uploads while giving staff clear file-check status and a recoverable processing path.
flow: Save the upload privately as pending
Defender for Storage scans the blob
Event Grid delivers the scan result to a queue
A separate processor binds the verdict to the exact version
notes: The cloud scanner is Microsoft Defender for Storage. The Python demo replays fictional verdicts; it does not detect malware.
Quarantine in this reference means blocked application retrieval, not an automatic move or deletion.
A stopped result processor can leave files pending even if the scanning service completed. Unknown and failed results remain unavailable.
boundary: Actual platform design; this screen demonstrates result handling with fictional scan events.
